summary: Tim Holm (22), Davis Gray (22), and Josh Jordan (21) stranded on the fifth pitch of Yellow Spur (5.10a) on Redgarden Wall after dark in rain, without headlamps; another climber heard calls for help and asked if they wanted a rescue. Twelve rescuers climbed to the top of the wall and assisted all to the ground; no injuries.
location: Yellow Spur, Redgarden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Fire Dept; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder Emergency Squad; Boulder County Sheriff Office
